question: Set in the holy city of Varanasi, ‘Kashi Ka Assi’ is written by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kashi Nath Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Kashi Nath Singh** is an Indian author known for his writings in Hindi literature.

• His book 'Kashi Ka Assi' is set in the holy city of Varanasi and captures the essence and spirit of the place.

• 'Kashi Ka Assi' offers a unique and vivid portrayal of the local culture, traditions, and everyday life in Varanasi.

• Kashi Nath Singh's work is highly regarded for its authentic depiction of the socio-political landscape of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Varanasi**

• Varanasi, also known as Banaras or Kashi, is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.

• It is situated on the banks of the Ganges River in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh.

• Varanasi is a major cultural and religious hub in India, known for its temples, ghats, and vibrant cultural heritage.

• The city is considered sacred by Hindus, Buddhists, and Jains, and attracts millions of pilgrims and tourists every year.

• **Hindi Literature**

• Hindi literature encompasses a wide range of poetic and prose works written in the Hindi language.

• It includes various genres such as poetry, novels, short stories, essays, and plays.

• Prominent figures in Hindi literature include authors like Premchand, Harivansh Rai Bachchan, and Mahadevi Verma.

• Hindi literature has played a significant role in the cultural and social movements in India, reflecting the country's diverse traditions and values.

• **Socio-Political Landscape**

• The socio-political landscape refers to the social and political environment in which a society operates.

• It includes factors such as governance, social norms, cultural practices, and economic conditions.

• Understanding the socio-political landscape is crucial for comprehending the context and background of literary works.

• Literature often serves as a mirror to the socio-political issues and challenges faced by a society, providing insights and perspectives on various aspects of life.
